question:
The given circle graph shows the annual spending of country “ABC' on various sectors during a particular year in the form of central angle). Study the circle graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32b40d5f68041fa55d864e226bfc20330f35b8800d1464a67bbdc1b58c296901.png] 

If the amount spent on industry and transportation during a year was $10 million, then what was the total approximate amount spent on all the various sectors by the country in that year?
solution:
&
lt;strong>Given:

Angle for industry = 62o

Angle for transportation = 55o

Total amount spent on industry and transportation = $10 million

Total angle of the circle = 360o

**Formula used:**

Total expenditure = (Amount spent on industry and transportation / (Angle of industry + Angle of transportation)) × Total angle

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total expenditure = (10 / (62 + 55)) × 360

⇒ Total expenditure = (10 / 117) × 360

⇒ Total expenditure ≈ 30.8 million

**∴ The total approximate amount spent by the country on all sectors is $30.8 million.**
